summary: Retest of iteration_4 WCAG 2.2 AA fixes. All 5 previously-serious violations are RESOLVED: /insights list/listitem = 0, and color-contrast on /insights/what-is-a-cmms, /insights/reactive-vs-preventive-maintenance, /contact, /tmms/demos/factory = 0. Keyboard flows, regression content and mobile nav testid fix all PASS. One remaining violation on '/' (color-contrast, serious, at rest — different from the previous flaky mid-animation one).

issues:
axe 'color-contrast' (serious) 3.81:1 on

containing 'Response within two working days'. Foreground rgba(255,255,255,0.4) => #717174 on background #121317. This is present at REST (verified after 3s wait, no animation), i.e. blocking. Fix: bump text-white/40 -> text-white/60 (or use a solid #B5B5B5) to reach >= 4.5:1.

/.note: Persistent after 3s wait — NOT mid-animation. Different from iteration_4 flaky violation.

keyboard_audit.mobile_menu_390: PASS — opens, mobile-nav-contact testid present (no duplicate prefix), Escape returns focus to mobile-menu-button.
keyboard_audit.demo_tour: PASS — next, skip, close testids present; Next advances; Escape dismisses.

action_items:
Fix /home color-contrast: raise the 'Response within two working days'

from text-white/40 to at least text-white/60 (or a solid ~#B5B5B5) — currently 3.81:1 vs required 4.5:1 (WCAG 1.4.3). This is the ONLY remaining WCAG 2.2 AA violation across the 11 audited routes.
critical_code_review_comments: Pattern of using low Tailwind opacity utilities (text-white/40, text-ink/50) recurs across the app. Consider adding a single design token pair for muted-on-dark and muted-on-paper that already meets 4.5:1 to prevent regressions.

success_rate.frontend: axe: 10/11 routes CLEAN (1 remaining serious color-contrast on /); keyboard 5/5 PASS; regression 100% PASS

context_for_next_testing_agent:
Only remaining WCAG issue: /home hero

'Response within two working days'. selectorable via p[x-id="HomePage_133_16"] or the class combo font-mono+text-white/40 inside the dark hero. All other 10 routes are clean under axe-core 4.10.2 with wcag2a/aa + wcag21a/aa + wcag22aa. Iteration_4's flaky Reveal-mid-animation violation on '/' did not reproduce this run.
rca of the issue:
Home hero note uses Tailwind text-white/40 which computes to #717174 on the near-black hero bg #121317 = 3.81:1. Needs >= 4.5:1 for AA on small text. Fix: change text-white/40 → text-white/60 (or /70) on that

.
